01. 3D CAD & FEA Center

Every valve model is fully customized using 3D parametric models with FEA stress analysis and CFD aerodynamics before fabrication.

02. Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)

Equipped with in-house hydro test rigs and pressurized air-seal leakage chambers for full witness testing by clients and inspection agencies.

03. Heavy Fabrication & Machining

Capable of handling large-bore damper valves up to DN6000+ with precision shaft alignment, refractory lining, and high-temp alloy welding.
